सूची अझै राखिएको छैन

No guest list has been published yet. Open the admin page on a laptop to upload one.

Open admin

कसको सूची?

1. Add a list from CSV

Columns: List, Title, Full Name, Sapariwar, Mobile, Address, Invitation. Names and addresses in English are converted to Nepali.

2. Or edit the published list

Loads the list that is live on the site so you can add guests or fix names.

#ListEnglish nameTitleNepali nameSapariwar English addressNepali addressInvitationMobileCardChecked

कार्ड

कार्डमा थिचिराखेर (long-press) पनि Save/Share गर्न सकिन्छ।

📞 फोन गर्नुहोस्

Publish the list

Then upload guests.enc to the GitHub repo next to index.html (replace the old one). Phones pick it up within a couple of minutes.
